slave.note: Built locally, NOT by the firmware team's release toolchain. Hardware-validated on two follower units: command channel survives sustained 1000Hz CMD_NO_ACK, rx_overflow and debug_tx_bytes both 0, stream-locked control loses no status frames. Size/CRC32 are not comparable with pre-1.1.2 entries (toolchain differs from the official one). POWER-CYCLE THE GRIPPER AFTER FLASHING - the bank-swap reboot is a soft reset and leaves the device dropping frames while every counter reads clean; see tc-gu-01 issue #6.
